ds: Applicants or insiders misstate income, assets, identity or property value to obtain credit, or use straw buyers and inflated appraisals. Mortgage fraud may involve collusion with brokers, valuers or conveyancers.

ctl.ds: Checks identity and supporting documents for tampering, forgery, template reuse and internal inconsistency, and corroborates their data against authoritative or reliable independent sources. It exposes altered or counterfeit credentials that pass a visual check.

Independently verifies stated income, employment, obligations and application facts against third-party, bureau and prior-history data at origination. It reduces application, credit and insurance fraud.

ctl.n: Sampling, quality assurance and analytics audit
ctl.ds: Takes periodic samples of customer files, alert decisions, relied-upon files or analytical datasets and tests them for exceptions, duplicates and errors, feeding findings back to owners and training. It independently confirms that controls work as designed.

Reviews and updates customer information on a risk-based cycle and when triggers occur, such as ownership change, key attribute change, adverse information or out-of-profile activity. Fresh data keeps risk ratings and expected-activity baselines current.
Clusters customers, vendors and entities that share addresses, phones, devices, officers or bank details, including against staff records. It reveals common control and hidden relationships.

Matches accounts, devices, identifiers and beneficiaries against industry fraud sharing and ingests law-enforcement, commercial and open-source threat feeds, including victim reports from other institutions. It catches known bad actors early.

Scores claims, links parties, providers and addresses, monitors repeat claims by region or intermediary and verifies payee identity and sanctions exposure before settlement. It uncovers organised and repeat claims fraud.

Provides protected, confidential channels for staff, workers and suppliers to report misconduct or concerns, together with conduct monitoring to surface insider collusion. It brings internal and supply-chain issues to light.

ctl.n: Funds hold, freeze and recall procedure
ctl.ds: Provides a defined, legally grounded capability to restrict, hold, freeze or recall funds and accounts pending review or on confirmed exposure, with clear triggers and approvers. It stops onward dissipation of suspected illicit funds.
Rules that alert on abnormal count, value or speed of movements over defined windows compared with customer profile and peer norms. They provide baseline coverage across many typologies.

ctl.n: Segregation of duties and dual authorisation
ctl.ds: Ensures no single person can create, approve and release a payment or master-data change, requiring an independent second approver. It controls insider and impersonation fraud.
